use_cases: Displaying product FAQs organized by category tabs for easy navigation
Building help center and support documentation pages
Creating collapsible FAQ sections with animated expand/collapse
Organizing company policies and guidelines by topic
ai_summary: A reusable FAQ component with category-based tab filtering and animated accordion-style question expansion. Features a gradient header, category tabs with hover states, and smooth Framer Motion transitions. Fully customizable with props for title, subtitle, categories, and FAQ data.
